errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. The specified text, '%ВЕИ в общоенергийната системна генерация', is the label for the solid blue line in the legend.
The data series begins in the year 2011, not 2010. The first data point is visibly to the right of the 2010 tick mark.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност около 0.85 в 2010 г. и показва постепенно увеличение, достигайки около 1.6 в 2050 г.
errors.evidence: The description invents numerical values (0.85 and 1.6) for the logarithmic trendline. The chart does not have a second y-axis or provide any values for this line; it is plotted against the same percentage axis as the main data.

errors.text_span: линията с логаритмични стойности има по-малък наклон
errors.evidence: Visually, the dotted logarithmic trendline and the solid line representing the data points have nearly identical slopes for the majority of the chart. Claiming it has a 'smaller slope' is an incorrect description of the visual information.
